gloss: becoming a dead letter; becoming an empty formality

definitions.gloss: becoming a dead letter; becoming an empty formality
definitions.explanation: The process by which a law, rule, agreement, or principle loses its practical force and becomes merely nominal. The rule still exists on paper but is no longer observed or enforced.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空文化|くうぶんか}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That regulation has become a dead letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条項|じょうこう}→条項：18974_joukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空文化|くうぶんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk that the constitutional provision will become an empty formality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空文化|くうぶんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実効性|じっこうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To prevent international treaties from becoming dead letters, each country needs to take effective measures.

notes:
A compound of {空文|くうぶん} (dead letter, empty text) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (becoming, -ification). Describes the process of a formally existing rule, law, or agreement losing its practical meaning. Common in legal, political, and academic discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空文化|くうぶんか}: a law becoming a dead letter
- ⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空文化|くうぶんか}: a treaty becoming an empty formality
- {空文化|くうぶんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent something from becoming a dead letter
- {空文化|くうぶんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: the process of becoming an empty formality advances

RELATED WORDS:
- {空文|くうぶん}: dead letter — a law or provision that exists but has no practical effect
- ⟦{形骸化|けいがいか}→形骸化：07645_keigaika⟧: becoming a mere shell — a similar concept applied more broadly to systems, institutions, and customs
